title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I woke in the hold of a barge among a gang of strangers. The door is locked. An Argonian woman named Okeeh is watching me. I should speak to her and find out where I am.
objectives: Speak to Okeeh in the barge's hold. (marker: Okeeh)

plan.going: I am in a locked ship's hold with strangers and know nothing else.
plan.next: Speak to Okeeh, the woman watching me.
plan.ways: There is one way on, to talk to her. I carry two lockpicks, but the door has no lock I can pick.

answers: I woke in a barge hold among strangers, door locked. An Argonian woman, Okeeh, is watching me. I do not know who I work for or why I am here.
Speak to Okeeh in the barge hold (marker).
Talk to Okeeh; there is also a lockpick I was given, and Dralin Uveran is nearby.
I do not know who Okeeh or Dralin Uveran are, or what the work roll is; I can find out by talking to them.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: Okeeh told me where I am: the hold of an Owing barge moored at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters' camp in Black Marsh, where the gang cut reed for the months they owe. I gave her my name, and now she wants to know what my trade was. She says the door stays barred until the gang-master takes our names.

plan.going: I am in the hold of an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters' camp in Black Marsh. The Owing is the marsh's sentence: months of owed work in place of a cell. The door stays locked until the gang-master takes the new gang's names.
plan.next: Tell Okeeh what my trade was.
plan.ways: Seven answers: warrior, hunter, thief, battlemage, healer, nightblade (each names the five skills it raises by five), or naming my own five skills one by one.

answers: I am on a work barge at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh, serving the Owing: months of owed work cutting reed instead of a cell. The gang-master Dralin Uveran will put our names on his roll and unlock the door.
Give my name, then tell Okeeh my trade.
Name entry, then choose a trade from seven topics; I can still ask Okeeh about the Hist, Jal-Veesa.
I do not understand what a Hist or Jal-Veesa is; I can ask Okeeh.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I told Okeeh I was a hunter. Then we heard the bar lift from the hold's door, and Okeeh told me I can go out onto the landing now, where the gang-master waits.
objectives: Go out onto the landing. (marker: Door to Barge Hold)

plan.going: My trade is told. The bar was lifted from the hold's door outside, and Okeeh told me I can go out onto the landing, where the gang-master waits.
plan.next: Go out through the door onto the landing.

answers: I told Okeeh I was a hunter and the door was unbarred. The gang-master Dralin Uveran waits on the landing to take my name onto his roll.
Go out the door to Ashgate Landing and speak to Dralin.
Go out now, or first ask Okeeh about the Hist or Jal-Veesa.
Still do not know what a Hist or Jal-Veesa is; I can ask Okeeh.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: Dralin Uveran, the Dunmer gang-master of Ashgate Landing, met me on the landing. He struck my name from his roll this morning, on an order brought by Vosh-Leera, the root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. He does not know why she wants me, and he is sour about it. He says she will have work for me if I bring her some Sithis' beard, a grey moss that hangs over the creek below Reed-Sill Weir, east up the road. I should pick the moss first, then take it to her house in Jal-Veesa, past the weir.

plan.going: I am free of the Owing: Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, had my name struck from the roll. I do not know why. She will have work for me if I bring her Sithis' beard.
plan.next: Pick Sithis' beard below Reed-Sill Weir, east up the road, then take it to Vosh-Leera's House in Jal-Veesa.
plan.ways: One way on, the moss first; the crocodiles under the weir can be fought, shot from the log walk or kept clear of.

answers: My name was struck from the Owing roll on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She will have work for me if I bring Sithis beard moss. I do not know why she wants me.
Pick Sithis beard, grey moss over the creek below Reed-Sill Weir east up the road (beware crocodiles), then take it to her house in Jal-Veesa past the weir.
Do the errand, or ignore it; I have no other leads.
I do not know who Vosh-Leera really is or what she wants, nor what a Hist or the tree of Jal-Veesa is; I could ask her or Okeeh.
